description: This file defines a console command 'AddDataGroupCommand' for the OrangeHRM system. It enables adding new data groups and associated API permissions through an interactive CLI interface, including options for simulation, validation, and database insertions.

classes.name: AddDataGroupCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class for adding data groups and API permissions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with input and output styles.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Handles interactive input prompts to gather data group and API permission details from the user.

methods.name: getModuleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocompleter question for selecting a module name.

methods.name: notBlankValidation
methods.description: Validates that input strings are not blank.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method to create and optionally persist data groups and API permissions, and display SQL scripts.

methods.name: printDataGroupTable
methods.description: Outputs a table summarizing the data group details.

methods.name: printDataGroupSQL
methods.description: Generates sample SQL insert statements for the data group.

methods.name: printApiPermissionTable
methods.description: Outputs a table summarizing the API permission details.

methods.name: printApiPermissionSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for API permission insertion.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Displays a block of message in console output.
